first_investigation.cpu_audit: Verify original 500 saved greedy answers, positions, labels and token vocabulary. For each complete step derive the immediately preceding token position and mark whether it is a generated delimiter. Exclude first-prompt positions from a matched-position comparison. first_investigation.replay_scope: Replay saved answers once for the existing selected decoder layer 20 only; no new calibration answers or layer search. Capture predecessor states and question-prompt means, compare captured first-content states against saved originals in the same forward pass. Save all finite FP32 states and per-question progress; output must be new. The first step's prompt token may be captured for audit but is excluded from matched generated-delimiter fitting.
first_investigation.replay_estimate: About 0.5 GiB new state plus small metadata; prior selected-layer-compatible decoder replay took about 124 seconds. Allow up to 15 minutes for this first replay including loading and checks; measured time reported, not assumed. Stop on mismatched input/model, OOM, invalid states or original-feature numerical mismatch and preserve progress.
first_investigation.candidate_comparison_before_generation: Three arms on a new fixed 100-question screen: original dynamic; matched-first vector excluding non-generated predecessor rows; predecessor-delimiter vector using exactly those same rows and labels. Both new vectors are scaled to the original raw-vector Euclidean norm to isolate orientation and hold dynamic parameters fixed. Matched-first is a confound control, not an optimization claim. No vectors combined.
first_investigation.generation_gate: Candidate must reduce mean thinking AND total tokens by at least 5%, have no fewer correct answers and no more caps than BOTH original dynamic and matched-first control. One run per arm. If passing, freeze candidate and confirm on independent reserved 200 training questions with fresh original dynamic; no parameter search on screen or reserve. Report paired uncertainty, not proven accuracy preservation.
alternative_hypotheses: The first-content hidden state may include token identity signals rather than a pre-generation behavioral commitment.
A preceding delimiter representation may carry a less separable behavior signal; matching positions may worsen generation.
Differences in calibration sample support alone may explain apparent benefit; matched-first controls this.
